title: Judicial (De Novo) Hearing on an Objection to a Referee Recommendation
what_it_is: The judge's review of a referee's recommendation after a timely, specific objection. "De novo" does not mean a fresh trial: by statute the judge may decide entirely on the referee-hearing record (MCL 552.507(6)(a)), but must allow live evidence (MCR 3.215(F)(2)) and may bar new evidence you could have offered to the referee and did not (MCR 3.215(F)(2)(c)).
who_is_in_the_room: The judge - reaches an independent decision, but on a record largely fixed at the referee hearing.
You and the other party (or counsel).
Possibly the referee's record/transcript, if either party gave the required 7-day notice to use it (MCR 3.215(D)(4)(c)).
sequence: You filed a written objection naming specific findings, plus a notice of hearing, within 21 days of service (MCR 3.215(E)(4)).
If you intend to offer evidence from the referee record, give notice at least 7 days before the judicial hearing (MCR 3.215(D)(4)(c)); the offering party generally pays for the transcript.
The judicial hearing must be held within 21 days after the written objection is filed, unless extended for good cause (MCR 3.215(F)(1)).
The court may review the referee record, must allow live evidence, and may bar new evidence, treat unobjected findings as conclusive, or impose other reasonable restrictions (MCR 3.215(F)(2)(a)-(d)).
The judge reaches an independent decision and enters an order.
prepare: Your finding-by-finding objection worksheet: the finding, why it is wrong (fact or law), and the record cite.
Only evidence you can show was NOT available at the referee hearing, if you want to introduce anything new - document that unavailability with a date.
The 7-day notice of intent to use the referee record, if applicable, already served.
A short statement of what you are asking the judge to do differently and why.

applicable_rules.summary: The court must allow live evidence; may bar new evidence not shown unavailable at the referee hearing, and may treat unobjected findings as conclusive.
A de novo hearing can be a new decision based entirely on the record of a previous hearing.
applicable_rules.disposition: VERIFIED verbatim - legislature.mi.gov fetch recorded in verification_ledger.md; NOT yet archived in sources/primary/mcl/ (empty for this section) - VERIFY before quoting in a filing

applicable_rules.summary: The judicial hearing must be held within 21 days after the written objection is filed, absent good-cause extension.
Costs and fees may be assessed for a frivolous or delay-motivated objection.

deadlines.label: Objection + notice of hearing (starts this track)
Notice of intent to use the referee record

traps.trap: Believing "de novo" guarantees a fresh trial.
traps.safe_move: It does not. MCL 552.507(6)(a) allows a decision entirely on the referee record. Everything you wanted heard should already be in that record.

traps.trap: Trying to introduce new evidence without showing why it was unavailable before.
traps.safe_move: MCR 3.215(F)(2)(c) lets the court exclude it. Document unavailability with a date, in advance.
Unobjected findings can be treated as conclusive (MCR 3.215(F)(2)(a)-(b)). Name each finding you dispute.
MCR 3.215(D)(4)(c) requires the offering party to pay; ask about cost and lead time the day you decide to object, not the week of the hearing.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Write down the date, who appeared, and what was decided or taken under advisement before leaving the building.
Write on any document handed to you the date you received it - that date can start a clock.
Calendar every deadline this event started, counted from the earliest possible trigger date.
Note whether anything was requested that you did not have time to answer fully, and follow up in writing.
